mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.activity_type AS category, COALESCE(t.color_code, '#27AE60') AS category_color, a.description, a.address AS location, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.recruit_count AS capacity, a.applied_count AS enrolled, CASE a.activity_status_id WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS status, a.activity_cover_url AS image, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.publish_user_id AS admin_id FROM volunteer_activity a LEFT JOIN volunteer_tag t ON t.tag_name = a.activity_type AND t.tag_type = 'activity_type'
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.activity_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND a.activity_status_id = CASE #{status} WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.activity_type AS category, COALESCE(t.color_code, '#27AE60') AS category_color, a.description, a.address AS location, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.recruit_count AS capacity, a.applied_count AS enrolled, CASE a.activity_status_id WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS status, a.activity_cover_url AS image, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.publish_user_id AS admin_id FROM volunteer_activity a LEFT JOIN volunteer_tag t ON t.tag_name = a.activity_type AND t.tag_type = 'activity_type'
AND a.activity_status_id != 4
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.activity_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.activity_type AS category, COALESCE(t.color_code, '#27AE60') AS category_color, a.description, a.address AS location, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.recruit_count AS capacity, a.applied_count AS enrolled, CASE a.activity_status_id WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS status, a.activity_cover_url AS image, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.publish_user_id AS admin_id FROM volunteer_activity a LEFT JOIN volunteer_tag t ON t.tag_name = a.activity_type AND t.tag_type = 'activity_type' WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_activity ( organization_id, region_id, activity_status_id, publish_user_id, title, activity_type, activity_cover_url, description, address, start_time, end_time, sign_in_start_time, sign_out_end_time, recruit_count, applied_count, favorite_count, share_count, service_hour, heat_value, publish_time ) VALUES ( 1, 2, CASE #{status} WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 4 ELSE 1 END, #{adminId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{image}, #{description}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity}, 0, 0, 0, 3.00, 0, NOW() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE volunteer_activity
title = #{title}, activity_type = #{category}, description = #{description}, address = #{location}, start_time = #{startTime}, sign_in_start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, sign_out_end_time = #{endTime}, recruit_count = #{capacity},
activity_status_id = CASE #{status} WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 4 ELSE 1 END,
activity_cover_url = #{image}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE volunteer_activity SET activity_status_id = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.activity_id, e.user_id, CAST(e.enroll_status AS UNSIGNED) AS status, e.enroll_time AS register_time, NULL AS check_in_time, NULL AS check_out_time, 0 AS hours, COALESCE(e.audit_remark, e.enroll_remark) AS remark, u.nickname AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, a.title AS activity_title, a.address AS activity_location FROM volunteer_activity_enrollment e LEFT JOIN volunteer_user u ON e.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity a ON e.activity_id = a.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_activity_enrollment SET enroll_status = #{status}, audit_remark = #{remark}, audit_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.activity_enrollment_id AS activityEnrollmentId, s.sign_in_time AS signInTime, s.sign_out_time AS signOutTime, CAST(s.sign_status AS UNSIGNED) AS signStatus, s.service_hour_actual AS serviceHourActual, s.confirm_user_id AS confirmUserId, s.qr_code_token AS qrCodeToken, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime, u.nickname AS userName, u.phone AS userPhone, a.title AS activityTitle, a.address AS activityLocation, e.user_id AS userId, e.activity_id AS activityId FROM volunteer_activity_sign s LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity_enrollment e ON s.activity_enrollment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_user u ON e.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity a ON e.activity_id = a.id WHERE s.activity_enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_activity_sign ( activity_enrollment_id, sign_status, service_hour_actual, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{enrollmentId}, '0', 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_activity_sign SET sign_in_time = NOW(), sign_status = '1', update_time = NOW() WHERE activity_enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND sign_status = '0'

UPDATE volunteer_activity_sign SET sign_out_time = NOW(), sign_status = '2', service_hour_actual = #{hours}, confirm_user_id = #{adminId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE activity_enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND sign_status = '1'
UPDATE volunteer_activity_enrollment SET enroll_status = '4', audit_remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{enrollmentId}

UPDATE volunteer_activity_enrollment SET enroll_status = #{status}, audit_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity WHERE activity_status_id = CASE #{status} WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity_sign WHERE sign_in_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(sign_in_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(snapshot_date), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM volunteer_home_stat_snapshot

SELECT stat_code AS code, stat_label AS label, stat_value AS value, stat_suffix AS suffix, stat_change_text AS changeText, color_code AS color FROM volunteer_home_stat_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM volunteer_home_stat_snapshot) ORDER BY FIELD(stat_code, 'total_hours', 'total_users', 'total_activities', 'total_communities'), id

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity a JOIN volunteer_activity_status s ON s.id = a.activity_status_id WHERE s.status_code = 'recruiting' ) AS recruitingActivities, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.applied_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.recruit_count), 0), 1) FROM volunteer_activity a JOIN volunteer_activity_status s ON s.id = a.activity_status_id WHERE s.status_code = 'recruiting' ), 0) AS recruitingFillRate, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity_enrollment WHERE enroll_status = '0' ) AS pendingReviews, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity_sign WHERE sign_in_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(sign_in_time) = CURDATE() ) AS todayCheckIns
SELECT stat_month AS month, activity_count AS activityCount, participant_count AS participantCount, total_hours AS totalHours FROM volunteer_monthly_stat_snapshot ORDER BY id

SELECT t.tag_name AS name, s.activity_count AS activityCount, CAST(REPLACE(s.percent_text, '%', '') AS UNSIGNED) AS percentage, t.color_code AS color FROM volunteer_category_stat_snapshot s JOIN volunteer_tag t ON t.id = s.tag_id WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM volunteer_category_stat_snapshot) ORDER BY s.activity_count DESC, s.id

SELECT r.region_name AS name, s.activity_count AS activityCount, s.participant_count AS participantCount, s.total_hours AS totalHours, s.heat_score AS heatScore FROM volunteer_region_stat_snapshot s JOIN volunteer_region r ON r.id = s.region_id WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM volunteer_region_stat_snapshot) ORDER BY s.participant_count DESC, s.id

SELECT e.id, e.activity_id, e.user_id, CAST(e.enroll_status AS UNSIGNED) AS status, e.enroll_time AS register_time, NULL AS check_in_time, NULL AS check_out_time, 0 AS hours, COALESCE(e.audit_remark, e.enroll_remark) AS remark, u.nickname AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, a.title AS activity_title, a.address AS activity_location FROM volunteer_activity_enrollment e LEFT JOIN volunteer_user u ON e.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity a ON e.activity_id = a.id WHERE e.activity_id = #{activityId} AND e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.enroll_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_activity_enrollment ( activity_id, user_id, enroll_status, enroll_remark, enroll_time ) VALUES ( #{activityId}, #{userId}, '0', #{remark}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enroll_status = '0', enroll_remark = #{remark}, enroll_time = NOW(), cancel_time = NULL, update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_activity_enrollment SET enroll_status = '3', cancel_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND enroll_status IN ('0', '1')
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.activity_id, e.user_id, CAST(e.enroll_status AS UNSIGNED) AS status, e.enroll_time AS register_time, s.sign_in_time AS check_in_time, s.sign_out_time AS check_out_time, COALESCE(s.service_hour_actual, 0) AS hours, COALESCE(e.audit_remark, e.enroll_remark) AS remark, u.nickname AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, a.title AS activity_title, a.address AS activity_location FROM volunteer_activity_enrollment e LEFT JOIN volunteer_user u ON e.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity a ON e.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity_sign s ON s.activity_enrollment_id = e.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.enroll_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_service_hour_change ( user_id, activity_id, activity_sign_id, change_type, change_source, change_hour, change_reason, operate_user_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{activityId}, #{activitySignId}, #{changeType}, #{changeSource}, #{changeHour}, #{changeReason}, #{operateUserId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, total_service_hour AS totalServiceHour, total_activity_count AS totalActivityCount, ranking_no AS rankingNo, last_calculate_time AS lastCalculateTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM volunteer_service_hour_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_service_hour_summary ( user_id, total_service_hour, total_activity_count, last_calculate_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{totalHour}, #{activityCount}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_service_hour_summary SET total_service_hour = total_service_hour + #{deltaHour}, total_activity_count = total_activity_count + #{deltaCount}, last_calculate_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, c.activity_id AS activityId, c.activity_sign_id AS activitySignId, c.change_type AS changeType, c.change_source AS changeSource, c.change_hour AS changeHour, c.change_reason AS changeReason, c.operate_user_id AS operateUserId, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime, a.title AS activityTitle, u.nickname AS userName FROM volunteer_service_hour_change c LEFT JOIN volunteer_activity a ON c.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
